ingame.note: 披露称生成式 AI 未用于制作任何游戏内内容资源。此为开发者自述，未经独立审计。
ingame.quote: Generative AI was not used to create any in-game content resources.

code.note: 本次官方披露未明确说明此领域；不能据此认定未使用。

art.note: 游戏内美术属于内容资源范围，披露称未使用生成式 AI。此为开发者自述，未经独立审计。
art.quote: Generative AI was not used to create any in-game content resources.

music.note: 游戏内音频属于内容资源范围，披露称未使用生成式 AI。此为开发者自述，未经独立审计。
music.quote: Generative AI was not used to create any in-game content resources.

voice.note: 配音属于内容资源范围，披露称未使用生成式 AI；翻译过的对白文本另见翻译领域。此为开发者自述，未经独立审计。
voice.quote: Generative AI was not used to create any in-game content resources.

writing.note: 披露称游戏内内容资源未用生成式 AI 制作，原文写作据此视为人工完成；AI 只做后续翻译。此为开发者自述，未经独立审计。
writing.quote: Generative AI was not used to create any in-game content resources.

translation.note: 披露称 AI 仅用于部分游戏内对白以及 Steam 页面、社区帖子等外部内容的翻译。
translation.quote: AI was utilized solely for the translation of certain in-game dialogue and external content, such as our Steam page and community posts.

marketing.note: 同一条披露点名了 Steam 商店页与社区帖子等对外文案的翻译由 AI 完成，属于商店宣传文本。
marketing.quote: AI was utilized solely for the translation of certain in-game dialogue and external content, such as our Steam page and community posts.

disclosureQuote: Generative AI was not used to create any in-game content resources. AI was utilized solely for the translation of certain in-game dialogue and external content, such as our Steam page and community posts.
summary: 虚幻 5 动漫风开放世界动作 RPG。开发者披露生成式 AI 未用于制作任何游戏内内容资源，AI 仅用于部分游戏内对白与 Steam 页面、社区帖子等外部内容的翻译；玩家社区对该翻译披露反应负面。
reviewNote: 核查 Steam 英文商店页完整 AI 披露、身份（开发商 Hound13 Inc.）与英文讨论区首页（可见 15 个主题，总数 278），首页没有与 AI 使用直接相关的主题，未逐帖展开。本款单独检索公开报道 1 次、登记 6 条结果，读取 2 篇原始来源（AI Transparency Index 条目、一条关于该披露的 Steam 社区主帖，含玩家不满原文）；Reddit 帖抓取返回 403，未能读取。领域判定全部来自商店披露原文，结论基于开发者自述，未经独立审计。
description: 官方披露把 AI 限定在对白与对外文案的翻译，并声明游戏内内容资源未使用生成式 AI。

english.summary: An Unreal Engine 5 anime-styled open-world action RPG. The developer states that generative AI was not used for any in-game content resources and that AI was only used to translate certain in-game dialogue and outward content such as the Steam page and community posts, a disclosure players reacted to negatively.
english.reviewNote: Reviewed the full English Steam AI disclosure, the identity (developer Hound13 Inc.) and the English discussion homepage (15 visible topics of 278); no homepage topic directly concerns AI use and individual threads were not opened. This title was searched once with 6 results logged and two raw sources read (the AI Transparency Index entry and a Steam community thread about the disclosure that records player dissatisfaction); a Reddit post returned HTTP 403 and could not be read. Every area finding comes from the store disclosure text and rests on developer statements, not an independent audit.

aiAreaNotes.ingame: The disclosure says generative AI was not used to create any in-game content resources. Self-report, not independently audited.
aiAreaNotes.code: This area is not addressed by the reviewed disclosure; that is not proof of non-use.
aiAreaNotes.art: Art falls under in-game content resources, which the disclosure says were not generative-AI made. Self-report, not independently audited.
aiAreaNotes.music: Audio falls under in-game content resources, which the disclosure says were not generative-AI made. Self-report, not independently audited.
aiAreaNotes.voice: Voice falls under in-game content resources, which the disclosure says were not generative-AI made, although translated dialogue is covered separately. Self-report, not independently audited.
aiAreaNotes.writing: The disclosure rules out generative AI for in-game content resources, so the source writing is presented as human while AI only translates it later. Self-report, not independently audited.
aiAreaNotes.translation: The disclosure states AI was used solely to translate certain in-game dialogue and external content such as the Steam page and community posts.
aiAreaNotes.marketing: The same sentence names store page and community posts, so the AI translation also covers outward marketing copy.
